does_not_modify: Original protocol bytes, model weights, cohort membership, original 144 forecasts, and first rolling batch are unchanged. This separate pre-outcome addendum defines operational eligibility/deadline rules and downgrades inferential wording in light of the simulation audit.

statistical_interpretation.inference_policy: A crossing of the registered numerical threshold will be reported as a pilot rule firing, NOT as validated statistical confirmation at a nominal 2.5% or 5% error rate. The procedure showed undercoverage in plausible synthetic scenarios. A future confirmatory experiment needs its own pre-outcome validated design, not a post-hoc replacement of this rule.
statistical_interpretation.power_statement: In the specified synthetic scenarios, rule firing at true delta=-0.007 is roughly 13% to 32%; non-confirmation is common, not predetermined. These are assumed scenarios, not guaranteed power for future data.

market_eligibility.valid_decimal_odds: All finite and strictly greater than 1.
market_eligibility.outside_band: Flag as ineligible for primary future market comparison; not necessarily a proven source error. Preserve raw values and reason. No guessed correction, opening substitution or bookmaker fallback.
market_eligibility.duplicates: Exact match identity and completed score must agree. Ambiguous or conflicting source rows are ineligible; no cherry-picking a price.
market_eligibility.snapshot: Record one pinned closing-data snapshot and its retrieval time/hash before running final comparison; later revisions are separate sensitivity analyses.
market_eligibility.covered_subset: Both model and market scored on exactly the same eligible rows. List every excluded fixture/reason.
market_eligibility.historical_3956: Historical primary benchmark remains unchanged, including the flagged row. New eligibility rule is prospective only.

cohort_and_deadline.final_analysis: One analysis once all 1000 games have completed eligible outcomes and all 1000 admissible pre-match forecasts are evidenced; if not available by cutoff, close as incomplete. No replacing games, extending until significance, or treating missing outcomes as zeros.
cohort_and_deadline.postponed: Keep cohort identity and first admissible forecast; include an eventual completed outcome through cutoff even after Apr 17. Note original and actual dates.
cohort_and_deadline.cancelled_or_unplayed_awarded: Keep in fixed denominator. No invented outcome. Report missing/void reason; no confirmatory claim for an incomplete cohort.
cohort_and_deadline.no_published_forecast: Remains in denominator and is missing, never reconstructed after kickoff. No replacement fixture.
cohort_and_deadline.missing_market: Counts against 1000-row closing-coverage denominator; market comparison cannot run below 950 valid rows.
cohort_and_deadline.cutoff_status: After cutoff, completed results may be descriptively summarized with exact numerator/denominator, but an incomplete experiment does not acquire a superiority conclusion.

publication_verification.required: For each batch, exact full commit ID and content hashes plus a platform/server publication timestamp strictly before actual kickoff. Git author/committer dates alone do not prove publication time.
publication_verification.server_example: GitHub public activity pushedAt, referencing the commit that first published the file. Original push verified at 2026-11-05T06:30:43.000Z.
publication_verification.hash_check: Read pinned public commit; hash forecast bytes, features, protocol reference and model references. Later commits cannot replace first admissible published forecast.
publication_verification.late_or_unverifiable: Missing proof of pre-kickoff publication is missing forecast coverage, not silently accepted.

automation: No future background scheduler/publication configured; operator still required.
